newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks post modest gains, trade lacklustre.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks post modest gains, trade lacklustre.

text.p: Tokyo stocks posted modest gains by midday on Monday, helped by strength in the U.S. markets on Friday and stability in currencies following the Group of Seven (G7) nations' summit meeting, brokers said. They added however that trade was thin.
The Nikkei 225 stood at 20,460.35, up 74.81 points or 0.37 percent at midday. Its September futures rose 40 to 20,510.

"Currencies were calm after G7 as the comments about Japan's trade surplus were all pretty much within market expectations which was a relief," said Hisao Suzuki, Yamaichi Securities deputy general manager.
